shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '*lock*' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'tsconfig*' -g 'README*'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,95p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'charts|chartkit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat AGENTS.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Select SegmentedRadioGroup ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeMode Text && rg -n -C 3 'useTheme|useThemeMode|--g-color-(text|base)-(utility|info|positive|float)|--g-color-line-generic' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json'

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Select SegmentedRadioGroup ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeMode Text && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg -n -C 3 'useTheme|useThemeMode|--g-color-(text|base)-(utility|info|positive|float)|--g-color-line-generic' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html && python - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/gravity-icons.html').read()
for term in ['moon','sun','arrow-down-to-line','arrow-up-right','chart-line','calendar','chevron-right','circle-question','sliders','arrow-rotate-right','persons','globe']:
 print(term, sorted(set(re.findall(r'.{0,45}'+term+r'.{0,65}',s,re.I)))[:3])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && rg -n 'utility|positive|info|float|background' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_light.scss | head -35 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -35 && cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs | head -45 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/theming.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/line.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/index.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-labels.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/legend.md'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -160 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && rg -n 'utility|positive|info|float|background' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -30 && rg -n 'ChartData|ChartProps|LineSeries|DashStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/*.d.ts | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm | rg '/types|interfaces|Chart/Chart' | head -55 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts && rg -n 'Moon|Sun|ArrowDownToLine|ArrowUpRight|ChartLine|Calendar|ChevronRight|CircleQuestion|ArrowRotateRight|Persons|Globe|Clock|CircleCheck|ChartColumn' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && rg -n 'interface ChartData|type ChartData|interface ChartProps|interface LineSeries|dashStyle|tickInterval|lineWidth' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && rg -n -A 18 'interface ControlGroupProps|interface ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,165p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts && rg -n -C 3 'ticks|grid|title|labels|plotLines|crosshair' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -125 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/base.d.ts | head -125 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/formatter.d.ts | head -110 && sed -n '1,85p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components/index.d.ts && rg -n -C 3 'DashStyle|margin' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '210,285p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts && sed -n '180,215p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/constants.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/css.d.ts && sed -n '1,95p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/tooltip.d.ts && rg -n 'text-positive|text-hint|line-generic|base-generic-ultralight' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/tooltip.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'color\\(|parseColor|normalizeColor|getColor' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/color* node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/shapes/line/*.js | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 -- '--g-button-padding|g-button__text|g-button_view_flat|g-button::before|g-button:before' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -110 && rg -n -- '--g-spacing-(7|8|9)|--g-color-line-utility|--g-color-base-generic-ultralight|--g-border-radius-l' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -25 && git diff --stat && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,85p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css && python - <<'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path
app = Path('src/App.css').read_text() + Path('src/App.tsx').read_text()
styles = Path('node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css').read_text()
refs = set(re.findall(r'var\\((--g-[\\w-]+)', app))
print('Missing UIKit tokens:', sorted(x for x in refs if x not in styles))
PY"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build > /tmp/pulse-build.log 2>&1 && tail -12 /tmp/pulse-build.log'
